name: OpenCode CLI
description: Installs the OpenCode CLI for the container user and stores the DARE reference config in the image; the feature's own postCreateCommand hook heals a missing CLI and rewrites the Kelpie baseURL per detected mode at container create.

version.description: OpenCode CLI version to install ("latest" follows the current upstream release).

configUrl.description: URL of the OpenCode reference config, stored at /opt/edag/opencode-config.reference.json. Empty string skips it (no reference config is stored).
